title: Recommendation latency increased after deployment
description: Recommendation API latency increased from approximately 2 seconds to 8 seconds shortly after a new deployment.

title: Kafka consumer processing lag
description: Kafka consumer lag increased continuously, causing delayed processing of user events.

title: Airflow DAG failed during BigQuery load
description: A scheduled production DAG failed while loading transformed records into BigQuery.

title: Recommendation API latency increased due to Redis cache latency
description: Recommendation API latency increased from the normal baseline after Redis response latency increased. Cache hit rate dropped significantly, increasing database load and causing elevated API latency.
